name: github_repo
description: Create and manage a GitHub repository using the gh CLI

steps.description: Verify gh CLI is available and authenticated
steps.expected_outcome: Logged in to github.com as USERNAME

error_patterns: Name already exists on this account
recovery_hints: Check gh auth status for permissions

example_params.content:
# My Project
Created by NLS agent.

example_params.command: cd my-project && git add -A && git commit -m "Initial setup" && git push
cd my-project && gh issue create --title "Setup CI/CD" --body "Set up GitHub Actions for testing"
cd my-project && git checkout -b feature/initial-setup && git push -u origin feature/initial-setup && gh pr create --title "Initial project setup" --body "Basic project structure"

learning_signals: gh CLI authenticates via: gh auth login (browser or token)
List repos: gh repo list, List issues: gh issue list, List PRs: gh pr list
